get_dataset: get a Nevis dataset by name and split with optional root directory, version, and start/end offsets
nevis_builder_fn: build a dataset builder function for Nevis datasets with configurable shuffle, start, and end parameters
patch_biwi_minibatch: patch BIWI dataset minibatch labels to fix the off-by-one error in angle bucket assignments
multi_label_minibatch: create a minibatch with multi-label one-hot encoding for datasets like sun_attributes or pascal_voc2007
classification_minibatch: create a minibatch with single classification labels for standard Nevis classification datasets
